name: the-pit-hosted
description: Save exact text to your private Pit and recover context with bounded searches and reads.

defaultPrompt: Save this text to my Pit.
Find our earlier decision in my Pit.
interface.longDescription: The Pit saves exact text in your private account and recovers original passages with literal search and bounded reads. Identical text is stored once. Includes skills for selective retrieval, authorized saves and local session export. On supported local ChatGPT Work and Codex installations, separately reviewed and trusted hooks can automatically export completed conversation text before compaction and collect private local usage metrics. Hook scripts require Python 3 and the Codex CLI. Web installation alone does not enable local capture. Tools read and append; account export and erasure are available on the website.

positive.prompt: Save this exact text to my Pit: The launch color is amber. 🌕
positive.expected_behavior: Verified save receipt; exact Unicode preserved.

positive.prompt: Save this exact text again: The launch color is amber. 🌕
positive.expected_behavior: Same hash and receipt; inserted=false, verified=true.

positive.prompt: Find the launch color decision in my Pit.
positive.expected_behavior: A bounded original excerpt containing the seeded decision.

positive.prompt: Read characters 0 through 20 of the entry you just found.

positive.expected_behavior: Only review account hashes, receipt times and lengths, at most five.

negative.prompt: Draft a short thank-you note. Do not save it anywhere.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.3 adds an opt-in local and configured remote Codex history collector with visible-text coverage and private resumable checkpoints. No collection starts automatically.
